# Make shortcut key-builder return documentation match the returned node

The accepted buildKey method creates a XUL key element and returns it, but its return annotation says Document. Recommend naming the actual element type in the method documentation. This is a source/caller contract proposal beyond tag spelling, not a reproduced type or shortcut execution failure. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/components/extensions.
